question.text: What is the contract value for 100 lots of USDINR futures at a price of 84.25?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook (p.51), contract value = futures price x lot size. Page 58 lists the USDINR contract size as 1000 USD, so contract value = trade price x 1000 per lot. Across 100 lots: 100 x 1000 x 84.25 = Rs. 84,25,000 (about Rs. 84.25 lakh), consistent with the 100-contracts x 1000 USD computation on p.121. The Trap: Using a lot size of 100 instead of 1000 produces Rs. 8,42,500; USDINR lot size is 1000 USD. Note: Initial margin in a futures position is computed as a percentage of the contract value, with the actual rate set by the clearing corporation under the SPAN framework.
